summary.text: Matt Coker is a Republican state representative from Belknap 2 who has represented the district since December 2024 after an earlier term in the same seat from 2022 to 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Coker is an airline pilot whose stated priorities are keeping taxes low, cutting red tape and preserving New Hampshire's character.

paragraphs.text: Matt Coker was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and earned a bachelor's degree from Liberty University in 2012.
His career experience includes working as an airline pilot, and he has been affiliated with the Air Line Pilots Association.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Coker said he moved to New Hampshire from Florida more than ten years earlier and described himself as a father of three daughters.
He said his three main priorities are keeping taxes low, cutting red tape and making government work for residents while maintaining New Hampshire's character.
He said he sponsored bills to reduce government red tape, including one to end inspections on brand-new vehicles, and bills on cyanobacteria mitigation in lakes.
